parts.text: Explain how X-rays are produced for use in medical diagnosis.

parts.text: State why X-ray images are taken of multiple sections of the body during computed tomography (CT) scan.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.lead:
An X-ray image is taken of the structure shown in Fig. 9.1.

[[fig:f1]]

The linear attenuation coefficient of bone is 3.4 cm⁻¹.
The linear attenuation coefficient of soft tissue is 0.89 cm⁻¹.

The incident X-rays are parallel and have a uniform intensity *I*₀ across the structure.

Determine, in terms of *I*₀, the intensity of the detected X-rays from:

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain, with reference to your answers in (b), whether the X-ray image of the structure in Fig. 9.1 has good contrast.
